capabilities: highlight and underline selected text with configurable colors and styles
attach comments to selected text passages
explain, translate, or annotate selected text with an AI provider
browse and jump to annotations from a sidebar
export all annotations as a separate Markdown note
extras: Fully offline by default; AI requests go only to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint and the API key is stored in the system keychain. Optional web search adds per-call provider fees. Documentation is provided in both English and Chinese. Installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Compared to PDF annotation plugins, FleurAnnotation focuses specifically on Markdown files
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to highlight, underline, or comment on text inside Markdown notes, and PDF annotation plugins do not cover Markdown files.

relations.evidence: with FleurDict installed the FleurDict lookup window opens
a local proxy such as Ollama or LM Studio keeps working

requires.name: AI provider (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Zhipu AI, Moonshot, Alibaba Qwen, etc.)

summary: Markdown annotation plugin that adds highlights, underlines, comments, AI explanation/translation, a sidebar index, and export of annotations.
